sentiment: The oldest things keep running quietly, while new growth coils into spirals no one taught it.

stories.title: Phyllotaxis: An audio-reactive LED display
stories.summary: A screen that grows the way a sunflower does — seeds spaced by the golden angle, one small turn at a time. Nothing is placed by hand; the pattern is arithmetic plus patience, and it fills the space on its own.

stories.title: Booted up in 1993, this server still runs – but not for much longer (2017)
stories.summary: A machine from another era, still humming along with almost no one watching. Longevity is its own quiet kind of beauty — a thing that keeps its rhythm long after the reason for it has thinned away.

stories.title: California farmers are struggling to sell grapes as demand for wine drops
stories.summary: Seasons keep arriving on schedule even when the market that needed them moves on. The vine does not know the demand fell — it grows because that is what it does, and the harvest waits to be wanted.
